title: Garlic & Herb Chicken
ingredients: 2.25 lbs (36 oz) boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized strips or tenderloins
4.5 tbsp dairy-free plant butter (e.g., Country Crock Plant Butter, Earth Balance, or Miyoko's)
instructions: Season the chicken: Pat the chicken pieces thoroughly dry with paper towels. Season evenly with the granulated garlic, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt and black pepper.

Sear the chicken: Heat the olive oil and 1.5 tbsp of the dairy-free butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken in a single layer (cook in two batches if necessary to avoid overcrowding). Sear 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F / 74°C). Transfer cooked chicken to a plate.
Make the pan sauce: Reduce heat to medium. Add the remaining 3 tbsp dairy-free butter and the lemon juice to the warm skillet, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Toss and serve: Return the chicken and any accumulated juices to the skillet. Toss continuously for 1 minute until well coated in the warm herb sauce.
Garnish: Remove from heat and sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley.
notes: Serving = ~5.5 oz cooked chicken with sauce (1 of 6 equal servings). Nutrition is an estimate per serving using plant-based butter. Also provides 3.5 g saturated fat and 95 mg cholesterol.
